_comments: The Buying team grid had no DefaultInView field, so MJ showed the first ten fields,
most of them IDs. The flags go on the view's name fields (SalesContact, BuyingRoleType, Deal), not the
foreign keys, so the grid shows words instead of GUIDs.
Deal is included because the same flag drives the buying-roles section on a Sales Contact's
form, where it is the only column that says which deal a role is on. On the deal's own form it
repeats the deal. Notes stays off: long text does not fit a grid column.
